insights.title: IFS Secures Low-Cost Carrier EFB Adoption
insights.finding: IFS secured MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air), classified as an LCC, as a customer for its IFS EFBOne platform.
insights.aviation_context: MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air) is an LCC operating cargo services.
insights.caveat: Captured text mentions cargo operations alongside its LCC identity.

insights.title: Aviobook Expands African Footprint with Royal Air Maroc Agreement
insights.finding: Thales (Aviobook) signed a five-year agreement with Royal Air Maroc for the AvioBook Flight EFB platform.
insights.aviation_context: Royal Air Maroc is a full-service carrier.
insights.caveat: Duration and scope are defined by the five-year agreement.

insights.title: Jeppesen Releases FliteDeck Pro Version 5.3
insights.finding: Jeppesen released ForeFlight FliteDeck Pro version 5.3 featuring the new Enroute Profile View capability.
insights.aviation_context: Commercial flight crew navigation aid update.
insights.caveat: Specific airline integration targets are not named in the release text.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Enhances Lido mPilot Mapping
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems released Lido mPilot 7.3 with aircraft-specific taxiway restrictions on Airport Moving Maps.
insights.caveat: Feature availability depends on individual airline rollout schedules.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Explores Business Unit Sale
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems is reportedly exploring a sale of its Lido and NetLine business units for approximately €1bn.
insights.aviation_context: Corporate restructuring of major airline IT and flight operations software providers.
insights.caveat: Report is based on financial press coverage rather than formal corporate closure.
